entities.name: Movses Kaghankatvatsi

entities.summary: Movses Kaghankatvatsi, or Movses Daskhurantsi, is the reputed author of a tenth-century Classical Armenian historical work on Caucasian Albania and the eastern provinces of Armenia, known as The History of the Country of Albania.
